policy: Primary sources only for mathematical claims; no exhaustive novelty certification.

sources.authors: Carlos E. Gonzalez-Guillen, Marius Junge, Ion Nechita
sources.title: On the spectral gap of random quantum channels
locators: Proposition 5.4 and its proof, printed pages 10-11
sources.inspection: Local PDF text, browser text, and visual inspection of printed page 10 (gjn-page10.png).
sources.use: Decoupling and moment estimates applied directly to Ginibre blocks with n=d=D and k=s. No Haar-isometry chi factor is imported.
sources.caveat: Use the pre-square estimate in the proof and p=O(log D); no claim that a term p/D can be absorbed into a uniformly bounded multiple of sqrt(p/D) for arbitrary p.

sources.authors: Z. D. Bai, Jack W. Silverstein
sources.title: Exact Separation of Eigenvalues of Large Dimensional Sample Covariance Matrices
sources.inspection: Downloaded primary author PDF and extracted cited pages locally; a later browser opening returned an internal error.
sources.use: Complex-entry sample covariance edge limits (1 plus or minus sqrt(c)) squared. Here c=1/s; apply separately to the two marginal laws.
sources.attribution: Lemma 1.2 attributes the edge result to Yin-Bai-Krishnaiah (1988) and Bai-Yin (1993).

sources.authors: Tsz Chiu Kwok, Lap Chi Lau, Akshay Ramachandran
sources.title: Spectral Analysis of Matrix Scaling and Operator Scaling
sources.use: Negative applicability check: capacity bound inherits lambda squared at least C epsilon log m. It does not directly settle fixed s and D tending to infinity; real-matrix formulation and capacity normalization also need attention.

sources.title: Fuglede-Kadison determinants of matrix-valued semicircular elements and capacity estimates
sources.inspection: Primary HTML read during the chain audit; no local PDF hash claimed.
sources.use: Prior determinant-capacity identity and the known scalar semicircle law for unital matrix-valued semicircular covariance. The uniform finite-moment argument over all amplification dimensions was audited separately.
